reason: I'd grab the free tricks, show them at a couple of dinners, and then they'd sit in my phone. I don't pay 99 shekels for an app, especially one I install from a website instead of the App Store.
objection: I'll use it twice and get bored, and paying by card on some random website for a browser-installed app feels sketchy.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks were so strong that friends kept begging for more, and the full version was more like 29-39 shekels through the App Store or Google Play.
